Event Types

Meetings
Thoughtfully designed spaces and attentive service come together to create the ideal environment for meaningful conversations and creative thinking. Our experienced events team takes care of every detail, ensuring your meeting unfolds effortlessly from start to finish.
Submit Enquiry
Conferences
Designed for conferences, seminars and corporate gatherings, our versatile spaces adapt effortlessly to your requirements. Supported by reliable technology and our experienced events team, every occasion is delivered with ease and precision.

Our Spaces

1,500 Guests
Grand Ballroom
The expansive Grand Ballroom is perfect for larger events. The venue can also be split into two smaller rooms and offers a ballroom foyer as an elegant reception area.
300 Guests
Diamond Ballroom
Located on the ground floor with its own separate entrance, the Diamond Ballroom can also be divided into two or three smaller rooms and offers a ballroom foyer, perfect for memorable photo opportunities.
150 Guests
Crystal Room
With its stunning décor and attentive service, it is designed to be the perfect space for those who wish to celebrate in a more personal and exclusive atmosphere.
70 Guests
Parkview Room
Ideal for conferences, seminars and corporate gatherings, this versatile venue offers flexible configurations, modern meeting facilities and the attentive service synonymous with Mandarin Oriental.

Mindful Meetings
Mandarin Oriental's Mindful Meetings programme is available at the Group's award-winning hotels in leading global destinations. We offer inspiring meeting venues from rooftops to boardrooms, Michelin-starred restaurants to alfresco garden or beachfront settings, and can provide world class cuisine, exemplary service and wellness activities to inspire.

Expert Planning

Technology
When it comes to technology, our facilities are second to none. Our audio visual technicians will set up all presentation equipment and provide efficient support throughout your event.
Catering
Our experienced culinary team specialises in creating menus that will thrill your guests and elevate your event to even higher levels.
Business Facilities
At Mandarin Oriental, Kuala Lumpur, flexible meeting spaces, attentive service and thoughtful planning come together to create memorable and successful business gatherings.
